name: Hints of a New Plague?
summary: Kinelory is ready to head down to the farm, and asks you to go with her. She fears the undead may harm Hillsbrad while they wait, and she needs you to see her safely back.

sections.title: Watching Kinelory's Back
sections.body: Kinelory is ready to act after the earlier steps of the investigation. She asks you to go with her down to the farm, then see her safely back to Quae. Anyone who cares about the people of Hillsbrad is urged to protect her.

sections.title: A Safe Return
sections.body: Quae thanks you when Kinelory returns. Quae admits to hoping Kinelory was not too much of a handful: Kinelory is very friendly, but just as deadly when you are her enemy.

faq.q: Who sends you on this escort?
aliases: who starts hints of a new plague 4
faq.answer: Kinelory asks you to go with her when she is ready to set out.

faq.q: Where does Kinelory need to go?
faq.answer: Kinelory goes down to a farm, then makes her way back to Quae.

faq.q: Who do you report to when finished?
faq.answer: You report to Quae once Kinelory has made it back to her.

faq.q: What came right before this part of the investigation?
faq.answer: The third part of Hints of a New Plague? leads straight into this part of the investigation.
The investigation continues with the fifth part of Hints of a New Plague?.
Anyone who cares about the people of Hillsbrad is urged to see Kinelory safely through.
